method: CSCV (Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado & Zhu 2017): S = 16 contiguous equal blocks (L = T // 16, remainder dropped from the end), all C(16, 8) = 12,870 IS/OOS splits; IS-best = highest IS mean (AUC) or IS Sharpe (returns); OOS relative rank r = (rank - 0.5) / M; logit = ln(r / (1 - r)); PBO = share of logits <= 0. Sensitivity variants (not the reading): remainder dropped from the start; all periods in 16 near-equal blocks; S = 14 equal blocks of 3.
pre_registered_reading: PBO above 0.5 means selection among those trials was no better than chance (ml/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md P5).
dropped_periods_warning: With T = 43 (configurations) or 45 (books) and S = 16, equal blocks are 2 periods long and the primary analysis uses 32 periods (2023-01..2025-08): 11 folds (2025-09..2026-07) or 13 months (2025-09..2026-09) are dropped from the end. The dropped stretch holds the 2025-09..2026-02 run and the March-2026 inversion, so the sensitivity variants that keep it are reported next to the reading.
duplicate_trials_note: baseline_mom and heuristic_mom20 books are identical in 36 (top_decile), 36 (ls_decile), 39 (liq_top_decile) of 45 months (one-feature logistic on the momentum rank vs the momentum rank itself), so 3 pairs among the 24 books are near-duplicates; OOS ties are average-ranked, which is why some OOS ranks are fractional.

skill.design: T = 32, M = 9, trial j has mean 0.15*j and sd 1 (true ordering known)

a_configurations_auc.text: PBO = 0.248 (not above 0.5): by the pre-registered reading, selection among these 9 model configurations was better than chance. PBO at or below 0.5 says only that the in-sample best usually finished in the out-of-sample top half; it is not by itself evidence of skill. With M = 9 (odd) the chance level of the 'lambda <= 0' rule is 0.556; strict rule PBO = 0.082, mid-rank PBO = 0.165 (chance 0.5).

b_books_all24.text: PBO = 0.184 (not above 0.5): by the pre-registered reading, selection among these 24 books was better than chance. PBO at or below 0.5 says only that the in-sample best usually finished in the out-of-sample top half; it is not by itself evidence of skill.

a_configurations_auc.input: fold AUC, 43 monthly folds 2023-01..2026-07 (holdout excluded) x 9 models

design.rank_convention: average ranks of the OOS statistic, 1 = worst, M = best; r = (rank - 0.5) / M; logit = ln(r / (1 - r))

degradation.note: OLS of n*'s OOS statistic on its IS statistic across the combinations; combinations overlap, so no standard errors are given. With complementary halves a single trial's IS and OOS means sum to twice its full-sample mean, so a negative slope is partly mechanical.

prob_loss.note: below_oos_median equals PBO except for combinations where n* sits exactly at the OOS median (possible only for odd M)

stochastic_dominance.note: first-order dominance of n* over all trials <=> F_best(x) <= F_all(x) for every x
